subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read the story Stop, thief! and find the shops in it.
Put the events of the story in order and describe the thief.

tf.s: Sami wants to buy a new mobile phone case for his mum.
tf.why: He wants a phone case for his mum.

tf.s: An escalator is a machine which carries you upstairs and downstairs.
tf.why: That is what an escalator does.

tf.s: Sami's mum loves the case which has a comet on it.
tf.why: She loves the case with the comet.

tf.s: The children go up the escalator after they look at the phone cases.
tf.why: First they go up the escalator, then they look at phone cases.

tf.s: The thief is the rude man who walked into Fatma earlier.

tf.why: The children see him stealing phones.

tf.s: The thief is carrying a red school bag.
tf.why: He is carrying a blue sports bag.

tf.s: Bo tries to stop the thief.
Shouting at children is good behaviour.
tf.why: Shouting makes children sad and afraid.

tf.s: The thief has got straight blond hair.
tf.why: He has got dark, curly hair and a moustache.

boxes.q: What does Sami want to buy for his mum?
boxes.why: He wants a new mobile phone case.

boxes.q: Why are the friends on the escalator?

boxes.why: He has a blue sports bag.

boxes.q: Complete: Bo tries to stop the ______.
boxes.why: Bo tries to stop the thief.

boxes.q: What has the thief got on his face?
Which word means "to take something that is not yours"?
Which is good behaviour towards younger children?
o: Help them when they have a problem.

boxes.q: Which case does Sami's mum love?
o: the one with a comet on it
the one with a car on it
boxes.why: She loves the case with the comet.

hunt.q: Picture on the case Mum loves
Who tries to stop the thief?

o: a machine which carries you upstairs and downstairs
mcq.why: An escalator carries people up and down.

mcq.q: How do the children know the man?
o: He is the rude man who walked into Fatma earlier.
He works in the phone shop.

mcq.why: These words are in Stop, thief!

o: a black T-shirt, blue jeans and trainers
a white shirt and a tie
mcq.why: That is the description in the story.

mcq.q: Put in order: a) They look at phone cases. b) They go up the escalator.
mcq.why: First they go up, then they look at phone cases.

o: He's got dark, curly hair and a moustache.
He's got no hair and glasses.
He's got red hair and a beard.

mcq.q: A younger child is lost in the shop. What is good behaviour?
o: Listen to them and help them.
mcq.why: We should listen, help and be kind.

mcq.q: How did the children know the man was the thief?
o: He was the rude man from earlier, and they saw him stealing phones.
He had a comet on his T-shirt.
mcq.why: They remembered him and saw him stealing.

mcq.q: Why is "Shout at children" not good behaviour?
o: It makes children sad and afraid.
mcq.why: Being kind is better than shouting.

mcq.q: Which action in the story is NOT good behaviour?
o: walking into people and stealing phones
mcq.why: The rude man's actions are wrong; the children's actions are good.
